bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to human services; appropriating money for children's mental health grants for respite care services.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; GRANTS FOR RESPITE CARE SERVICES. +]

[+$....... in fiscal year 2026 and $....... in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for children's mental health grants for respite care services for children with mental illness or serious mental illness under Minnesota Statutes, section 245.4889, subdivision 1, paragraph (b), clause (3). +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to human services; appropriating money for children's mental health grants for respite care services.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; GRANTS FOR RESPITE CARE SERVICES.

$....... in fiscal year 2026 and $....... in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for children's mental health grants for respite care services for children with mental illness or serious mental illness under Minnesota Statutes, section 245.4889, subdivision 1, paragraph (b), clause (3).

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
